description: Full detail for one regulatory update, by id or slug: the AI analysis (executive summary, what changed, who is affected, actions required, key dates, compliance impact, citations), any deadline, any enforcement penalty data, and related records. Call this after regmonitoring_search_updates when you need to judge what an update actually requires. Check the analysis `depth` field: "deep" means real structured analysis, "rationale" means only a short classification note. Set include_source_text to read the original document text.

id.description: Record id, as returned by regmonitoring_search_updates.

include_source_text.description: Include the full scraped text of the source document. Off by default because it can run to tens of thousands of characters. Present on ~72% of records; ask for it when the analysis is not enough to judge impact.

slug.description: URL slug, the last path segment of a regmonitoring.com/updates/... link. Use this or id; id is faster.

name: regmonitoring_get_update
title: Get update detail
